name: Kitchen Lab
description: Recipes as experiments: measure, mix and watch what changes, with each step read aloud.

about.concept: Measurement and change of state. A recipe is a procedure with quantities; mixing, heating and cooling change texture, volume and color in ways the child can predict and see.
about.progression: Free play is an open kitchen where she mixes, heats, cools, blends and bakes, with a recipe book of guided recipes. The Challenges ladder climbs from pre-K mixing, hot and cold, and floating or sinking, through melting, measuring cups and heat moving, to 7th and 8th grade acids and bases, leavening gas, browning reactions, conservation of mass and scaled-up ratios.
lifeSkills: Noticing how things change when combined
